svg.title: Google reviews taken down after user reports, 2019 to 2021
svg.desc: Three bars show more than 580,000 in 2019, more than 960,000 in 2020, and more than one million in 2021. Google did not publish a directly comparable figure in the later annual updates used for this audit.
svg.text: A smaller, different measure: user reported takedowns
Google’s published annual figures for reviews reported directly by users
This is a subset of moderation actions, not a success rate for business reports.
Source: Google annual updates for 2019, 2020 and 2021. Compiled by ReviewRemoval.
